kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge create-api-destination --api-destination-name api-destination-name --connection-name connection-name --http-api-parameters '{"Endpoint":"http://127.0.0.1:8001/api\n","Method":"POST"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApiDestination

parameters.help_en: The name of the API destination. The name must be 2 to 127 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: API名称，最大长度127个字符。最小长度2个字符
parameters.name: api_destination_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the connection configuration. The name must be 2 to 127 characters in length.

<notice>Before calling this operation, call the Connection operation to create a connection configuration. Set ConnectionName to the name of an existing connection.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
连接配置名称。最大长度127个字符。最小长度2个字符。

<notice>需要先调用Connection接口创建连接配置，ConnectionName填写已存在的连接名称。></notice>
parameters.name: connection_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the API destination. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The endpoint address of the API destination. The address can be up to 127 characters in length
fields.help_zh: API端点的接入点地址。最大长度127个字符
fields.name: endpoint

parameters.help_en: The configuration information of the API destination
parameters.name: http_api_parameters
